name: bioc_version
title: Bioconductor version for an R version

origin.description: Returns the Bioconductor version for the current or the specified R version.

arguments.name: r_ver
arguments.text: R version to use. Defaults to the running R version.

origin.details: Observes R_BIOC_VERSION. A non-empty value is returned as the Bioconductor version and r_ver is ignored. Otherwise the minor version, the first two components, is looked up. The builtin map runs from R 2.1 to 4.4. A missing minor is read from the Bioconductor config.yaml file.
origin.value: A Bioconductor version, a package_version object.

translation.description: Returns the Bioconductor version for the current or the specified R version.

arguments.name: r_ver
arguments.text: R version string, such as 4.5.0 or 3.4. None uses the installed R version, the same value as getRversion().

translation.details: A non-empty R_BIOC_VERSION is returned and r_ver is ignored. The minor version is the first two numeric components. The builtin map covers R 2.1 through 4.4 and does not download. A missing minor is parsed from config.yaml with the same regular expressions as the R code, then the text is cached. If that R version matches both a release and a devel Bioconductor version, release wins. If neither matches, the last row is kept, so R 4.5 is 3.22. A minor older than 2.1 is an error. A minor newer than the map is the devel version.
translation.value: The Bioconductor version as a dotted string.
translation.example:
from remotes.bioc import bioc_version
print(bioc_version())
print(bioc_version("3.4"))
